summary:
Full cryptographic audit and end-to-end Rust migration plan for BIP39-ABOARD-SDK.
Features:
- Technical audit of current TypeScript services vs. Rust crate parity
- Comprehensive architectural blueprint for ERC-4337 Account Abstraction & Paymaster engine in pure Rust
- Cryptographic specification for ERC-5564 Stealth Addresses & View-Key Scanner in pure Rust with k256 curve mathematics
- High-performance Rust AML threat engine with bitmask bloom-filter screening and taint tracing
- WASM bridge (wasm-bindgen) & Native C-ABI (FFI) bindings
- Zero-Plaintext RAM security audit with ZeroizeOnDrop enforcement
- Phase-by-phase implementation and migration strategy with verification criteria
